北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京很冷哦，体感低至 -15℃，记得多穿暖和！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is very cold, feels like -15℃. Remember to dress warmly!
北京.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪北风四级，体感 -7℃，风大更冷，注意防风保暖哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has a strong wind, feels like -7℃. Keep warm and stay windproof!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海气温 -1℃，体感有点冷，出行别忘添衣保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is chilly at -1℃, feels colder. Don't forget to layer up!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，气温 8℃。早晚温差大，注意适时增减衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy at 8℃. Mind the temperature changes and dress accordingly.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳气温 11℃，体感 6℃。风力不小，出门记得添衣。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is 11℃ but feels like 6℃. A bit windy, remember to add layers.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感降至 -7℃，北风三级，体感很冷，注意防寒哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels like -7℃ with a north wind. It's very cold, keep warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，气温 -6℃，体感 -11℃。路滑慢行，注意保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy and feels like -11℃. Drive carefully and stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 3℃，体感微凉，出门记得添衣保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and a bit chilly at 3℃. Remember to dress warmly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感降至 -9℃，湿冷感强，多穿些暖和的衣物吧。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels like -9℃, a damp cold. Bundle up in warm clothes!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温 -2℃。湿度大，体感更冷，多加衣物哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and -2℃. High humidity makes it feel colder, dress warmly!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雨，气温 5℃，体感 3℃。出门记得带伞，小心路滑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is rainy at 5℃. Remember your umbrella and watch your step!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -33℃。务必裹严实，防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -33℃. Bundle up tightly to avoid frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -33℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳气温 -28℃，体感 -32℃。户外活动一定要注意保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is -28℃, feels like -32℃. Be extra careful to stay warm outdoors.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -32℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，气温 6℃。早晚温差大，穿衣注意保暖哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny at 6℃. Mind the temperature swings, dress warmly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门气温 9℃，体感 2℃。风力四级，记得穿得暖和些！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is 9℃ but feels like 2℃. Strong wind, remember to dress extra warm!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 -16℃，风力四级。海边风大，多穿厚外套哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -16℃ with a strong wind. Bundle up with a thick coat!
青岛.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连气温 -13℃，体感 -19℃。户外寒冷，注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is -13℃, feels like -19℃. It's cold outside, keep warm and windproof.
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃
